title: Run a cable tray between two points on a level
task: Create an electrical CableTray between two XYZ points on a level with CableTray.Create (cable tray type first, then the two points, then the level -- the same shape as Conduit.Create). Covers MEP cable-tray modelling.

pitfalls.symptom: The cable tray is mis-placed because arguments were passed in the Duct/Pipe order.
pitfalls.cause: CableTray.Create's signature is (Document, ElementId cabletrayType, XYZ start, XYZ end, ElementId level) -- type first, level last, like Conduit.Create and unlike Duct/Pipe.Create.
pitfalls.fix: Pass trayType.Id, start, end, level.Id in that order.

pitfalls.symptom: First() throws InvalidOperationException 'Sequence contains no elements' collecting CableTrayType.
pitfalls.cause: The template has no cable-tray content loaded.
pitfalls.fix: Confirm the CableTrayType collector is non-empty before First(); use an electrical/systems template or load cable-tray families first.
